background_subtraction_window — VIDEOSTREAM window op

• Data kinds: video → video

• Call: import videostream; videostream.background_subtraction_window(video, window: 'int' = 5, threshold: 'float' = 0.1) -> 'np.ndarray' (or opsvideostream.get("background_subtraction_window"))

Usage

Causal window-median background → per-frame 0/1 foreground masks `(T, H, W) (video`).
